name: Quite Apps
metaTitle: Quite Apps — free Chrome extensions to remove ads & clutter
metaDescription: Free, open-source Chrome extensions from an independent UK studio. Remove YouTube ads and clear your Facebook feed. One permission each, no tracking.
leadIn: We are a small independent studio in the UK. We make Chrome extensions that take things away rather than add them — and we publish the source, so you never have to take our word for what they do.
heroLead: Two open-source Chrome extensions that take the advertising and the clutter out of the sites you use most. One permission each. No accounts, no tracking, nothing sent anywhere.
install: Click Load unpacked and select the folder you unzipped.
installNote: Chrome shows a "Developer mode extensions" warning each time it starts. That is normal for anything installed outside the Web Store, and it can be dismissed.

principles.title: One job, done properly
principles.body: Every extension has a single purpose and runs on a single site. If a feature does not serve that purpose it does not ship, however much we would enjoy building it.

principles.title: The fewest permissions we can ask for
principles.body: One permission each, plus access to the one site the extension is for. No access to your other tabs, no browsing history, nothing that reaches beyond the job.

principles.title: Read the code yourself
principles.body: Both extensions are MIT licensed and public on GitHub. Nothing is sent anywhere, there is no server and no analytics — and you do not have to trust us on that, because you can check.

contactBody: Bug reports, feature requests, or a note to say something broke after a site update — all welcome, and all read by the person who wrote the code. Issues on GitHub work just as well.
donateBody: Both extensions are free, MIT licensed and always will be. There is no paid tier waiting behind them. If one has saved you some irritation and you feel like putting something in the hat, it keeps the work going — and if not, that is genuinely fine.
installFirstRelease: Download the latest release and unzip it. You need the folder — keep it somewhere permanent, because moving or deleting it stops the extension working.
installFirstZip: On GitHub, click the green Code button, choose Download ZIP, and unzip it. You need the folder — keep it somewhere permanent, because moving or deleting it stops the extension working.
